::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 31st 1875  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS The Hypatia Trust
:::

My dear [Mrs Harte](people/person_639.qmd)

If you can spare the 12th chapter of [Disobedient Cecil](other_books/otherbook_859.qmd) please send it direct to [Messrs Mozley](organizations/other_108.qmd) at Derby, as they want to set it up

yours sincerely
C M Yonge
